name: Plumber
description: Maintains an app you shared with friends. Fixes on a branch, never merges.
about: Point it at an app you built for yourself and shared with a few friends. If the app doesn't have Plumber, it sets it up on a branch. After that, each run it collects what went wrong, saves each failure as a case, and fixes up to two things on a branch. A fix is only proposed if it passes every case saved so far, and nothing merges without you.
features: Turn every "that was wrong" into a saved case
Fix up to two things per run, on a branch
Ship a fix only if every saved case passes
examplePrompt: Check what went wrong in my app since the last run and fix what the evidence supports.
